name: Action Manga
traits: extreme foreshortening, with hands and feet thrust at the lens
speed lines, impact bursts and motion streaks
dramatic low and high angles with tilted horizons
heavy inks with sharp hatching and high-contrast light
bestFor: a product shown as the decisive move
exaggerated everyday battles (a stain, a deadline, a wilting plant)
suits: energy drinks, sports gear, cleaning products, gadgets, games, anything with a 'power move'; bold, competitive, funny-epic brands
stylePara: Dynamic action manga brought to life in colour: bold heavy ink lines with sharp pressure tapers and aggressive hatching on shadow sides; extreme foreshortening, with hands and objects thrust toward the lens at exaggerated scale; dramatic low and high angles with tilted horizons; speed lines, radial focus lines and motion streaks drawn as inked strokes behind moving forms; cel colour with hard, high-contrast shadow shapes, rim light from behind, and impact flashes drawn as white starbursts; backgrounds dissolve into speed lines during action; it looks hand-inked and energetic, never 3D.

rendering.line: heavy, sharp ink line with fierce tapers; dense hatching and cross-hatching on shadow sides
rendering.shading: hard two-tone cel shadows, strong rim light, occasional dot screentone in the darks
rendering.colour: saturated, high-contrast colour with deep shadows; backgrounds can drop to a single flat hue behind speed lines; product colours exact
rendering.texture: inked speed lines and hatching strokes, debris flecks, dust and impact bursts drawn by hand
rendering.lighting: dramatic backlight and rim light, flashes of white on impact, strong directional key

motion: Explosive pose-to-pose motion on twos and threes: a held wind-up, then a one- or two-frame smear into a held impact pose; camera shake on impacts; speed lines streaming behind the move; a freeze on the key pose with a short slow push; debris and hair whipping with the motion.
camera: Wide lens close to the subject for foreshortening, low-angle heroic frames, a fast whip pan or crash zoom into the impact, Dutch tilts; a brief shake on hits; holds on the strongest pose.
avoid: calm eye-level staging with level horizons
smooth 3D-rendered motion blur instead of drawn speed lines
hands and the product melting into smears during the move
sheets: Each character sheet shows front, three-quarter and side plus two foreshortened action poses (a reaching hand toward the camera, a low-angle stance) in the exact line weight and colours; the product is drawn at normal scale and in a foreshortened close view with its exact silhouette and colours.
risk: Fast action is where Seedance breaks: hands, faces and the product smear or change shape mid-move, and it renders blur instead of drawn speed lines. Put the product in a held pose at the start and end of the move, keep the smear to under a quarter second, and say 'drawn ink speed lines, no motion blur'. Sound-effect lettering appears unbidden; forbid it in NO TEXT.

example.prompt: Action manga still in colour: a woman in her thirties with a dark bun and an orange top thrusts a small green glass bottle with a yellow cap toward the lens in extreme foreshortening, her hand and the bottle huge in the foreground, low dramatic angle with a tilted horizon; a sunny kitchen behind her breaking into radial inked speed lines, a droopy fern on the windowsill caught in rim light; heavy tapered ink lines, sharp hatching, hard cel shadows, a white impact burst behind the cap. Vertical 9:16. No text.
